title: Print hit object order
body:
I want to print the key index of the results shown inside my template, is there any way to do that? Is there any key index value to represent the order of the results (eg: "hitOrder")? For example: ``` var hitTemplate = '
' + '

#{{hitOrder}}. {{ title }}

'+ '
'; ``` #1. Lorem ipsum... #2. Lorem ipsum... #3. Lorem ipsum... ....

comments.body: I'm not sure to get what you mean by `hitOrder`. Is it something from your records? Or should it be a computed value?

Do you want the index?

```
[ search box ] 

1. best result
2. second result 
...
9. last result
```
@Haroenv, yes! I'd like to display the index of results.

The data is not available in the `item` template but you could use the `allItems` template instead which let you control all the output. And if you really need the full control, you can always use a function instead of a template.

-- SOLVED -- Just noticed that there is a hit index inside the hit object as __hitIndex Thus, the solution would be: ``` var hitTemplate = '
' + '

#{{__hitIndex}}: {{ title }}

'+ '
'; ```
I've never heard of that... that's weird :)

Ok so it's there since 1.6.0, and it was first introduced as __position (and it's there [in the code](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/5cd002b0c2442cc952d59cecab335a55e61cbd35/src/components/Hits.js#L13)). Happy that you solved your issue :)

I'll open an issue to document that.
